# Football. LIVE

> Football match notifications and live scores in Telegram via LiveScoreAppBot — personal DMs, groups, channels, and a Mini App. Canonical marketing host: https://football-live-bot.online

Static claim-safe summary for LLM agents. Stick to shipped product facts from the capabilities catalog; do not invent unshipped surfaces.

## Locale homes

- [English](https://football-live-bot.online/en)
- [Arabic](https://football-live-bot.online/ar)
- [Spanish](https://football-live-bot.online/es)
- [French](https://football-live-bot.online/fr)
- [Portuguese](https://football-live-bot.online/pt)
- [Russian](https://football-live-bot.online/ru)

Each home covers product overview, how-it-works, Chat Premium (49 Stars / 30 days for groups and channels), FAQ, and a live official league channels list.
